main.title: Samsung SDS 컨소시엄, 2.5조원 규모 국가AI컴퓨팅센터 최종 계약 완료
main.body:
과학기술정보통신부는 5월 11일 삼성SDS 컨소시엄을 국가AI컴퓨팅센터 구축 민간 참여자로 최종 확정하고 실시협약과 주주 간 계약을 체결했다. 컨소시엄은 삼성SDS, 네이버클라우드, KT, 카카오, 삼성전자, 삼성물산, 클러쉬, 전라남도, 서남해안기업도시개발 등 9개사로 구성됐다.

공공 1,160억원과 민간 2,840억원을 합친 총 4,000억원 규모의 민·관 출자가 확정됐다. 삼성SDS는 30% 지분을 가져가고, 정부는 29%의 2대 주주로 참여한다. 총 2조5000억원 규모 센터는 2028년까지 첨단 AI반도체 1만5000장 확보를 목표로 한다.

센터 위치는 전남 해남 솔라시도 데이터센터 파크이며, 2분기 내 SPC 설립 후 3분기 중 착공에 들어간다. 삼성SDS는 7월부터 리벨리온 NPU를 활용한 NPUaaS(NPU-as-a-Service) 서비스도 제공할 계획이다.

부총리 배경훈은 "이번 협약을 통해 국가AI컴퓨팅센터가 민간의 AI 인프라 투자를 촉진하는 모델이 될 것"이라고 밝혔다. 중소기업·스타트업·연구자들이 저렴하게 AI 컴퓨팅 자원을 활용할 수 있는 혁신 허브 역할도 기대된다.

main.select_reason: 한국 소버린 AI 인프라의 최대 단일 본계약(2.5조원, AI반도체 1.5만장)이자 리벨리온 NPUaaS 본격 상용화로 임직원 주목도·시장 영향·primary-source 정부 발표 3축이 모두 최상위.

main.title: AMD's 2nm defection to Samsung dents TSMC's AI grip
main.body:
The AI semiconductor supply chain is showing unexpected signs of a shift, with TSMC's long-held dominance in the foundry market beginning to loosen. US chipmakers are increasingly engaging with Samsung Electronics and Intel as alternative suppliers.

AMD's decision to move 2nm production to Samsung represents a notable challenge to TSMC's previously unchallenged position in advanced AI chip manufacturing. Samsung Foundry has reportedly won a 2nm notebook CPU order from AMD, identified as being for AMD's Venice or Verano processors.

AMD CEO Lisa Su personally visited Samsung's Pyeongtaek foundry campus in March to discuss potential 2nm production partnerships. With TSMC's advanced node capacity choked until 2028, Samsung appears to be AMD's next best option for manufacturing Venice and Verano CPUs in sufficient volumes. AMD's Venice, launching in 2026, sports up to 256 'Zen 6C' cores, while Verano will be a variant specifically designed for Agentic AI workloads.

Samsung's improving 2nm yields may help AMD diversify production while giving Samsung another high-profile foundry customer after Tesla. The talks come as demand for high-performance computing chips continues rising during the rapid expansion of agentic AI systems.
main.keep_reason: AMD Venice/Verano(에이전틱 AI 워크로드 변형) 2nm를 삼성 파운드리로 이전 — MangoBoost가 깊이 연계된 AMD 생태계의 공급망 재편 신호로 협업 기회 카테고리에 직결.
main.select_reason: MangoBoost 핵심 파트너 AMD의 차세대 Venice/Verano CPU 2nm를 TSMC 대신 삼성에 발주 — 글로벌 AI 칩 공급망 재편의 분수령으로 직원 주목도·시장 영향·대중 관심도 모두 최상위.

main.title: Cerebras bumps up IPO range as it looks to raise up to $4.8 billion
main.body:
Cerebras Systems increased its estimated IPO price range to $150-$160 per share, up from the prior range of $115-$125 per share. At the top end, the company would raise up to $4.8 billion in proceeds. The Nasdaq listing is expected on May 14, 2026 under the ticker symbol CBRS, with the final price set on May 13.

Cerebras received orders for more than 20 times the number of shares made available for sale, demonstrating extraordinary investor demand. The company is considering raising the number of shares marketed to 30 million from 28 million. The listing is on track to be the biggest IPO globally in 2026 to date, according to Dealogic.

Cerebras brought in $510 million in revenue in 2025, with a net income of $237.8 million. The company announced an agreement with Amazon Web Services to use Cerebras chips in Amazon data centers, as well as a deal with OpenAI reportedly worth more than $10 billion. Cerebras makes specialized wafer-scale chips better suited for inference operations—the computations that allow AI models to respond to user queries—than traditional GPU chips.

The company was acquired by NVIDIA for ~$20B earlier in 2026 through its Groq acquisition, making the Groq LPU architecture part of the Vera Rubin platform. Cerebras is now pursuing its independent path to market.

main.select_reason: 5/14 나스닥 상장 직전 가격대 30% 상향(20배 oversubscription) + AWS·OpenAI 100억$ 계약으로 2026년 최대 IPO 확정 — AI 추론 가속기 시장 자본 재편의 가장 강한 시그널.

main.title: "파업이냐, 타결이냐"…삼성전자 노사, 오늘 '사후조정' 결론 낸다
main.body:
삼성전자 노사가 오늘(12일) 사후조정 절차를 마무리하며 5월 21일 총파업 여부를 결정한다. 노조는 성과급 상한(연봉의 50%) 폐지와 제도화를 요구하고 있으며, 사측은 이를 거부하고 특별 보상 패키지를 제시한다.

노조(전국삼성전자노동조합) 위원장 최승호는 "우리 입장은 변함없이 영업이익의 15% 성과급과 상한 폐지 제도화"라고 밝혔다. 사측은 영업이익의 10%를 성과급 재원으로 사용하고 3년 후 제도화하겠다고 제안했다.

합의 실패 시 파업으로 30조 원 손실이 발생할 수 있으며, JP모건은 최대 43조 원 피해를 추산하고 있다. 중앙노동위원회 중재위원 황기돈은 "타협이 쉽지 않다"면서도 대화가 계속되고 있다고 밝혔다. 2차 사후조정은 5월 12일 오전 10시 정부세종청사 중앙노동위원회에서 열린다.
main.keep_reason: 삼성전자 5/21 총파업 여부 결정 + JP모건 추정 최대 43조원 손실 — AI 칩 공급망과 메모리/파운드리 수급에 직접적인 challenges 신호.
main.select_reason: 5/12 당일 결론 시점성 + JP모건 43조원 손실 추정 — 메모리/파운드리 수급에 글로벌 AI 칩 공급망 차원의 challenges로 모니터링 필수.

main.title: Smallest.ai and Tenstorrent Partnership Democratises Voice AI — 4x reduction in cost through hardware acceleration
main.body:
Smallest.ai has partnered with Tenstorrent to deploy Lightning V2, a real-time text-to-speech model optimized for hardware acceleration. This collaboration delivers significant cost reductions in voice AI infrastructure.

The partnership marks the first production-grade TTS system operating under aggressive low-precision computation. Lightning V2 achieves 3.6x lower infrastructure cost with higher throughputs and faster response times than leading GPU alternatives.

The model was rebuilt specifically for Tenstorrent's architecture, with over 95% running in reduced-precision arithmetic and more than 80% in BlockFloat8 format. The engineering team spent extensive time validating audio quality at the perceptual level, as voice models require different optimization approaches than language models.

Supporting 550 simultaneous voice calls costs approximately $27,000 on Tenstorrent P100 versus $100,000 on NVIDIA L40S hardware. The solution addresses regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, telecoms), growth-stage companies, and high-volume operations requiring on-premises deployment for data sovereignty and compliance.

About Tenstorrent: An AI compute company led by CEO Jim Keller—architect of Apple A4/A5, AMD Zen, and Tesla's Full Self-Driving chip—building RISC-V-based AI processors and systems for developers, enterprises, and sovereign infrastructure worldwide. Lightning V3 is in development, reportedly outperforming competitors on key voice quality benchmarks.
main.keep_reason: Tenstorrent P100 vs NVIDIA L40S에서 TTS 추론 비용 3.6배 절감 실증 — DPU/AI 인프라 비용·효율 challenges 및 GPU 대체 가속기 경쟁사 제품 카테고리에 정확히 부합.
main.select_reason: P100($27K) vs L40S($100K)에서 3.6배 비용 절감을 production-grade로 실증 — GPU 대체 AI 가속기 경쟁사의 가장 구체적인 워크로드 경제성 케이스.

main.title: Compute And Memory Price Hikes Drive IT Spending Way Higher
main.body:
Global IT spending is reaching unprecedented levels driven by surging demand for computing and memory resources. According to Gartner's latest forecast, worldwide IT expenditure will reach $6.32 trillion in 2026, representing a 13.5% increase from 2025's $5.56 trillion.

The expansion reflects intense component shortages combined with escalating prices. Demand for CPU and GPU compute as well as main memory and flash storage were already so high that IT spending in 2026 was going to set an all-time record.

Datacenter systems spending demonstrates the most dramatic growth trajectory. Gartner revised its 2026 forecast from February's projection of 31.7% growth to an extraordinary 55.8% increase, reaching $788 billion. This revision added $134.6 billion in anticipated spending—equivalent to the entire datacenter market size in 2012-2013.

The GenAI revolution primarily fuels this expansion, concentrated among hyperscalers, cloud providers, and AI model developers including Anthropic and OpenAI. These organizations are simultaneously investing directly in infrastructure while securing substantial capacity from existing providers.

Core IT spending—encompassing datacenter hardware, software, and services—now comprises 64.9% of total IT budgets, compared to 35.9% in 2012. This structural shift underscores how AI workloads are reshaping enterprise technology priorities and reshaping global economic patterns surrounding infrastructure investment.
main.keep_reason: Gartner 2026 글로벌 IT 지출 $6.32T(+13.5%) 및 데이터센터 시스템 +55.8%($788B) 상향 — MangoBoost TAM/시장 규모 인식에 직결되는 매크로 시장 인텔리전스.
main.select_reason: Gartner 2026 글로벌 IT $6.32T(+13.5%)·데이터센터 시스템 $788B(+55.8%) 상향 — MangoBoost TAM 매크로 시장 인텔리전스의 가장 권위 있는 분기 업데이트.

main.title: [이슈플러스] 삼성, 패키징·기판 등 반도체 후공정 투자 추진…생태계 수혜 촉각
main.body:
삼성전자가 AI 칩 수요 증가에 힘입어 첨단 반도체 패키징과 차세대 기판 역량 확대에 나선다. 회사는 차세대 시스템 반도체 패키징(2.5D, 3D, CPO 기술 포함) 분야 연구개발 및 장비 투자를 확대할 계획이다.

삼성전자는 온양·천안 캠퍼스에서 패키징 공정을 운영 중이며, 해당 시설의 투자 확대가 예상된다. 패키징 물량이 늘어나면 OSAT(외주패키징테스트) 기업들의 수주도 늘어날 수 있어 생태계 업체들이 주목하고 있다.

업계 관계자는 "단순 메모리 패키징을 넘어 2.5D, 3D, CPO 등 차세대 시스템 반도체 패키징 기술의 R&D 및 장비 투자가 확대될 것"이라며 "전공정 웨이퍼 생산능력이 확장되는 만큼 후공정 투자도 불가피하다"고 말했다.

삼성은 AI 응용을 위한 유리기판 및 SoCAM(고급 메모리가 내장된 시스템온칩) 모듈에도 투자하고 있다. 유리기판은 기존 플라스틱 소재 대비 미세 회로 구현이 용이하고 휨 현상이 적어 차세대 AI 반도체 기판으로 주목받는다. 삼성은 2025년부터 유리기판 공급망 구축에 착수했다.
main.keep_reason: 2.5D/3D/CPO 등 차세대 AI 칩 패키징 + 유리기판/SoCAM 투자 확대 — Co-Packaged Optics는 AI 인프라 네트워킹/대역폭 challenges에 직접적인 기술 트렌드.
main.select_reason: 2.5D/3D/CPO + 유리기판/SoCAM 후공정 투자 확장 — CPO는 차세대 AI 네트워킹 대역폭 challenges에 직결되는 기술 흐름으로 카테고리 분산(products)에도 기여.

main.title: Elon Musk, Tim Cook among CEOs to join Trump on China visit, Nvidia's Jensen Huang not included: Report
main.body:
President Donald Trump is traveling to Beijing this week for a major summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping, bringing along several prominent American business leaders. The delegation includes Tesla's Elon Musk, Apple CEO Tim Cook, BlackRock chief Larry Fink, Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon, and Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg.

The May 13-15 visit will emphasize trade, manufacturing, aviation, and investment deals between the US and China during a period of heightened tension regarding AI chips, tariffs, and supply chains. The administration is pursuing major commercial agreements, including potential Boeing aircraft orders and expanded Chinese purchases of American goods.

The delegation comprises more than a dozen senior executives spanning technology, banking, aerospace, agriculture, and payments sectors. Participants include Meta executive Dina Powell McCormick, Blackstone CEO Stephen Schwarzman, Citigroup CEO Jane Fraser, Qualcomm chief Cristiano Amon, Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra, GE Aerospace CEO Larry Culp, and leaders from Mastercard, Visa, Cargill, Coherent, and Illumina.

Notably absent is Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. While the U.S. approved exports of Nvidia's H200 AI chip to China, the Chinese government has effectively blocked imports, according to the White House official. The White House aims to prioritize agriculture, manufacturing, and aviation discussions rather than AI chip disputes.

Both nations remain in disputes over semiconductors, electric vehicles, Taiwan, rare earth minerals, and export controls. Officials will discuss extending current trade agreements that have temporarily eased retaliatory restrictions on critical technology exports.
main.keep_reason: 트럼프 방중 대표단에 NVIDIA 젠슨 황 제외 + H200 중국 수출 사실상 차단 — 반도체/AI 칩 수출 통제 정책 substance가 명확하여 KEEP.
main.select_reason: 5/13-15 트럼프 방중 대표단에 Jensen 제외·Qualcomm·Micron CEO 포함 + H200 중국 수입 차단 — AI 칩 수출 통제 지형 변화의 강한 시그널.

competitor_articles.title: Inference is giving AI chip startups a second chance to make their mark
competitor_articles.body:
As AI adoption transitions from training to inference operations, specialized chip startups are gaining newfound opportunities to compete against Nvidia's dominance. The shift matters because inference workloads differ substantially from training—they're far more heterogeneous and may benefit from specialized hardware architectures.

The inference pipeline itself divides into two distinct phases: prefill (computationally intensive) and decode (bandwidth-constrained). This separation has enabled a disaggregated approach where different chip types handle different tasks.

Nvidia's strategy exemplifies this model. After acquiring Groq in December, the company leveraged Groq's SRAM-optimized LPUs for the bandwidth-heavy decode phase while routing compute-intensive prefill operations to its GPUs. AWS followed suit with a platform pairing its Trainium accelerators for prefill with Cerebras Systems' wafer-scale processors for decode. Intel announced a similar reference design combining GPUs with SambaNova's RDUs.

Most startup wins have concentrated on decode acceleration, where SRAM's speed advantages prove decisive. However, innovation continues beyond this domain. Lumai unveiled an optical computing system for inference that uses light, rather than electrons, to perform the matrix multiplication operations at substantially lower power consumption than traditional digital architectures.

Not all startups embrace disaggregation. Tenstorrent's CEO Jim Keller criticized the trend, stating: 'Every company in the industry is pairing up to build the accelerator accelerator accelerator,' arguing instead for simpler, more unified solutions.
competitor_articles.keep_reason: Prefill/Decode 분리 추세, NVIDIA-Groq, AWS-Cerebras, Intel-SambaNova, Tenstorrent 입장 등 인퍼런스 가속기 시장 구조 변동을 종합 — DPU 인접 전략 컨텍스트로 foundational context 예외 적용.

competitor_articles.title: Elon Musk, Tim Cook among CEOs to join Trump on China visit, Nvidia's Jensen Huang not included: Report
competitor_articles.body:
President Donald Trump is traveling to Beijing this week for a major summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping, bringing along several prominent American business leaders. The delegation includes Tesla's Elon Musk, Apple CEO Tim Cook, BlackRock chief Larry Fink, Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon, and Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg.

The May 13-15 visit will emphasize trade, manufacturing, aviation, and investment deals between the US and China during a period of heightened tension regarding AI chips, tariffs, and supply chains. The administration is pursuing major commercial agreements, including potential Boeing aircraft orders and expanded Chinese purchases of American goods.

The delegation comprises more than a dozen senior executives spanning technology, banking, aerospace, agriculture, and payments sectors. Participants include Meta executive Dina Powell McCormick, Blackstone CEO Stephen Schwarzman, Citigroup CEO Jane Fraser, Qualcomm chief Cristiano Amon, Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra, GE Aerospace CEO Larry Culp, and leaders from Mastercard, Visa, Cargill, Coherent, and Illumina.

Notably absent is Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. While the U.S. approved exports of Nvidia's H200 AI chip to China, the Chinese government has effectively blocked imports, according to the White House official. The White House aims to prioritize agriculture, manufacturing, and aviation discussions rather than AI chip disputes.

Both nations remain in disputes over semiconductors, electric vehicles, Taiwan, rare earth minerals, and export controls. Officials will discuss extending current trade agreements that have temporarily eased retaliatory restrictions on critical technology exports.
